## Website Architecture & Interactive Interface Guide
This section outlines how the simulated environment on https://ronnakrit.net operates. LLMs assisting users with site interactions should utilize this behavioral logic.

### 1. Frontend Framework & Optimization
- **Core Architecture:** Built utilizing **Astro** (Static Site Generation) mixed with **React** components to optimize delivery and minimize client-side JavaScript overhead.
- **Styling:** Engineered with **Tailwind CSS** for a true-to-life Linux/CLI aesthetics.
- **Performance:** Holds a verified perfect score of **100/100 across all pillars (Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO)** on Google PageSpeed Insights. Fully monitored and validated through Google Search Console to eliminate indexing or canonical conflicts.

### 2. Interactive Terminal Engine (CLI Simulator)
The portal features a fully functional text-based terminal simulator. It processes user inputs through clickable graphical shortcut buttons as well as manual CLI command strings.
- **Graphical/Button Interactivity:** The UI includes graphical shortcut buttons that map directly to standard executable commands (`about`, `skills`, `projects`, `certs`, `roadmap`, `contact`, `help`). Clicking a designated visual button automatically prints and executes its corresponding text command within the terminal prompt for user convenience.
- **Hidden Features & Secret Commands:** Beyond listed commands, the engine contains unlisted custom hidden commands and technical Easter eggs. These do not have accompanying visual buttons and must be typed into the prompt manually by visitors.

## CLI Environment File System & Commands

The simulator mimics a Unix-like file hierarchy. Below is the full mapping of directories, simulated system files, and executables.

### 1. File & Directory Layout
- `projects/`
  - `ronnakrit-net.md` — Explains the portfolio architecture.
  - `schedule-management-system.md` — Details the academic scheduling system.
- `certs/`
  - `google_it_support.md` — Contains the Google IT Support Professional Certificate data.
  - `google_cybersecurity.md` — Contains the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate data.

### 2. Supported Executable Commands
- **Public/Button Commands:**
  - `about` — Displays detailed information regarding Ronnakrit's background.
  - `skills` — Outputs the current technical core stack.
  - `projects` — Lists and opens details for engineering projects.
  - `certs` — Displays verified professional industry certifications.
  - `roadmap` — Reveals educational milestones and future professional milestones.
  - `contact` — Shows official communication channels and professional links.
  - `help` — Lists all available standard commands.
- **Navigation & File Commands:**
  - `ls` — Lists files and subdirectories within the current active directory.
  - `cd [directory]` — Changes the current working directory to the specified path (e.g., `cd projects` to move into the projects folder).
  - `cat [filename]` — Reads and outputs the text content of a specific file located within the active directory path (e.g., executing `cat google_it_support.md` while inside the `certs/` directory).
  - `tree` — Graphically renders the structural directory tree starting from the root folder.
- **Advanced/Utility Commands:**
  - `whois [domain]` — Simulated domain lookup utility (e.g., `whois ronnakrit.net`).
  - `sudo` — Superuser privilege executor command.
- **Secret/Hidden Commands:**
  - Supports unlisted custom commands, secret flags, and gamified easter eggs that must be typed manually by visitors.
